content: Use a workflow of Concept → Custom GPT → Image-to-Storyboard → Seedance 2.0 (on yapper_so) to turn an initial concept into a storyboard and then generate the final video in Seedance.
tips: Use a workflow of Concept → Custom GPT → Image-to-Storyboard → Seedance 2.0 (on yapper_so) to turn an initial concept into a storyboard and then generate the final video in Seedance.

es.content: Utiliza un flujo de trabajo de Concepto → GPT Personalizado → Imagen-a-Storyboard → Seedance 2.0 (en yapper_so) para convertir un concepto inicial en un storyboard y luego generar el video final en Seedance.
